channel.title: Radovar updates
channel.description: Dated updates from Radovar, the company behind Codevalanche.

item.title: A new radovar.com
item.description: The site now introduces Radovar as the company and Codevalanche as its first product. Codevalanche stays in early access for Windows. We are working on a new version, not yet published, and public downloads are in preparation.

item.title: Codevalanche 0.1.31 published
item.description: The most recent build in the June and July early-access archive, one of nine published that day.

item.title: Early-access builds for Windows
item.description: Signed Windows installers with an update feed. Version 0.1.11 is the earliest build in the archive.
